bearer.description: A token from `POST /v1/tokens`, in four nesting scopes: admin, workspace, peer, session. Each operation below names the narrowest one that may call it.

info.description:
Pair-scoped memory. Every fact belongs to a directed (observer, observed) pair: what bob remembers about alice is not what alice remembers about herself, and no route crosses that line.

Three tiers of read: `context` assembles a session's summary and recent messages within a token budget, `recall` ranks conclusions by six fused signals, and `chat` runs an agentic loop over both when the answer needs more than one lookup.
info.title: aimon-memory
